Activities: Confirm business facts, audience hypotheses, desk research, objectives/KPIs, architecture, risks and tools.
Deliverables: Approved business foundation; cited research; target framework; architecture; risks; project plan.

Activities: Define relevant SERPs and genuine direct/search competitors; record page types, proposition, UX, content and observable signals; identify gaps.
Deliverables: Dated competitor evidence register and opportunity summary; no invented traffic/backlink metrics.

Activities: Collect/cluster queries with free and/or paid tools; classify intent, locale and funnel; prioritize; map to pages.
Deliverables: Keyword register, intent clusters, prioritization method, page map; source and estimate labels.

Activities: Audit priority templates/pages; prepare titles, headings, descriptions, internal links and content briefs; obtain approvals.
Deliverables: Audited page set, recommendations, approved implementation tickets and QA evidence.

Activities: Crawl live/staging site; inspect indexation, URL controls, canonicalization, sitemap, CWV, structured data, mobile and releases.
Deliverables: Prioritized technical audit, reproducible evidence, tickets, release/verification record.

Activities: Identify content gaps after query and business research; build briefs, editorial schedule, review/update standards.
Deliverables: Content strategy, briefs and editorial plan; publishing only if separately approved and supported.

Activities: Review available backlink evidence; assess legitimate relationships/assets; plan ethical outreach and monitoring.
Deliverables: Backlink baseline with tool limitations; white-hat opportunity and outreach plan.

Activities: Determine real eligibility and footprint; if eligible, audit profile and local data; otherwise document why not applicable.
Deliverables: Eligibility decision and local action plan, or documented not-applicable rationale.

Activities: Verify GSC/GA4, ecommerce events, consent and backend reconciliation; define reports and QA cadence.
Deliverables: Measurement specification, QA record, dashboard/reporting framework and baseline capture plan.

Activities: Consolidate work/evidence; distinguish plan, implementation and measured outcomes; draft case study and limitations.
Deliverables: Professional report and portfolio case study with source trail and accurate outcome statements.
